meta.name: migrate-nanoclaw
meta.description: Extracts user customizations from a fork, generates a replayable migration guide, and upgrades to upstream by reapplying customizations on a clean base. Replaces merge-based upgrades with intent-based migration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把分叉代码升级到上游版本并保留自定义修改
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你维护上游项目的分叉,想在不丢失自定义改动的前提下完成升级。
copy.tagline_en: Upgrade your fork to upstream while keeping your custom changes.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a fork and want to upgrade without losing your custom changes.

howto.what: 它会读取你在 NanoClaw fork 里做的自定义改动，生成一份 markdown 迁移指南，记下改了什么、意图和实现细节；升级时在上游干净代码上照指南重新应用，不用 git merge，因此没有合并冲突。
howto.when: 当你想把定制过的 NanoClaw fork 升级到上游版本时触发；如果已存在迁移指南，它会先问你是跳去升级还是更新指南。

say.text: 帮我把 fork 的自定义改动提取成迁移指南
上游更新了，在干净基础上重新应用我的改动
say.note: 先在 worktree 验证，再动本地安装

say.text: 已经有迁移指南了，直接开始升级
say.note: 跳过提取，进入升级阶段

howto.what_en: It reads your customizations in a NanoClaw fork and writes a markdown migration guide capturing intent and implementation details. On upgrade it reapplies them on clean upstream code, so there is no git merge and no merge conflicts.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to upgrade a customized NanoClaw fork to upstream. If a guide already exists, it asks whether to skip to upgrade or update the guide.

say_en.text: Extract my fork's customizations into a migration guide
Upstream changed; reapply my changes on a clean base
I have a guide already, go straight to upgrade
